thread:
alex: FYI running into a weird one — after rotating an API key locally and using the dev HTTP proxy the SDK starts returning a weird handshake/401. Repro steps below.

maria: ugh that sounds like the proxy is dropping or rewriting headers. which SDK version?

alex: sdk-js 1.14.0 (just pulled). Works fine without proxy. With proxy we see: 
```
ERROR: 401 Unauthorized - credential handshake mismatch: expected project-scoped key
       at RedwoodClient.request (/usr/src/app/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/lib/index.js:412:23)
```

sam: can you paste the proxy logs? sometimes the local proxy injects an X-Local-Auth header and the SDK's auth detection gets confused.

alex: proxy log excerpt: 
```
-> POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.dev
X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1
X-Local-Auth: project=dev-proj;key=redacted
```
Notice the proxy rewrites and drops X-Project-Id that we set in our sampleapp.

irene: oh, so the rotated key was stored as REDWOOD_API_KEY but the sample app sets REDWOOD_PROJECT via env var. Proxy didn't forward it so SDK tries to parse X-Local-Auth and fails validation.

alex: yep. Repro commands: 
```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-rotated-abc
export REDWOOD_PROJECT=dev-proj
node sample-app/server.js --use-local-proxy
curl -v http://localhost:3000/trigger
```

maria: short-term fix — change proxy to forward REDWOOD_PROJECT header or at least preserve X-Project-Id. Long-term: SDK should prefer explicit env var/project arg over parsing extraneous headers.

sam: agreed. Also if SDK detects X-Local-Auth, it should validate format and fall back gracefully to env var before throwing. We had an earlier convo about brittle header parsing in edge cases.

alex: I can open a small PR that does two things: (1) update sample-app to set an explicit `X-Project-Id` header when proxy mode is on, (2) add defensive fallback in auth detection: prefer explicit env/constructor param, then headers, then parsed local-auth.

irene: sounds good. For the fallback, can you add a unit test covering missing headers + rotated key? We saw flaky e2e in CI for proxy tests.

alex: yep I'll add tests. Plan: open PR with changes to sample-app and sdk-js auth detection. linking draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 (WIP)

maria: also file a short note in onboarding docs — mention that local proxies must forward project header or run with `--skip-proxy-auth` for dev flow. New devs tripped over this yesterday.

alex: will add docs blurb.

dev-bot: CI status: sdk-js/unit-tests — queued.

sam: minor thought — could we log a non-fatal warning when header parsing fails, instead of hard 401, during local-dev? Flag it behind `REDWOOD_DEV_STRICT_AUTH=1` maybe.

irene: +1 to warning. Keep strict mode opt-in so we don't mask real auth issues in prod.

alex: ok PR will include: sample-app header fix, sdk-js fallback + warning behind env var, unit test. I'll ping this thread when PR is ready.

maria: thanks — appreciate the quick triage. :thumbsup:
